ActiveRun.description: A run in progress, as listed in ``welcome``.
ActiveRun.title: ActiveRun

AgentActor.description: The built-in agent of one thread, acting within one run.
AgentActor.title: AgentActor

AnswerDeferred.description: Answer a paused run's question, or approve or deny one of its tool calls.
AnswerDeferred.title: AnswerDeferred

AppEvent.description: An application-defined fact. ``name`` identifies it; ``data`` is free-form JSON.
AppEvent.title: AppEvent

Applied.description: The change was applied: the artifact is now at ``version``.
Applied.title: Applied

ArchiveArtifact.description: Archive an artifact. Archived artifacts can be read but not changed.
ArchiveArtifact.title: ArchiveArtifact

ArtifactChanged.description: An artifact was changed by a patch.
ArtifactChanged.title: ArtifactChanged

ArtifactCreated.description: An artifact was created at version 1.
ArtifactCreated.title: ArtifactCreated

CommandFrame.description:
A client's command, with an id that correlates it with its result.

``command_id`` is also an idempotency key: the server deduplicates repeated ids.
CommandFrame.title: CommandFrame

CommandResult.description: The result of one command frame.
CommandResult.title: CommandResult

CreateArtifact.description:
Create an artifact.

If the artifact type's write policy (or the thread's mode) requires an agent to propose,
the command is recorded as a proposal with ``proposal_id`` instead.
CreateArtifact.title: CreateArtifact

DeferredAnswered.description: A paused run's request was answered.
DeferredAnswered.title: DeferredAnswered

DeferredRequest.description: A tool call a paused run is waiting on: a question to answer or a call to approve.
DeferredRequest.title: DeferredRequest

Draft.description: A full snapshot of an artifact being generated, not yet committed.
Draft.title: Draft

EditArtifact.description:
Apply a patch to an artifact, based on a specific version.

If the artifact type's write policy (or the thread's mode) requires an agent to propose,
the command is recorded as a proposal with ``proposal_id`` instead.
EditArtifact.title: EditArtifact

ErrorFrame.description: A frame the server could not understand, or a failure it could not attribute.
ErrorFrame.title: ErrorFrame

EventFrame.description: A durable event, delivered in its envelope.
EventFrame.title: EventFrame

ExternalAgentActor.description: An agent outside artifactr, connected over MCP.
ExternalAgentActor.title: ExternalAgentActor

FocusChanged.description: The set of artifacts a thread is focused on changed.
FocusChanged.title: FocusChanged

Hello.description: The first frame a client sends on a connection.
Hello.title: Hello

LiveFrame.description: A live event of one run, as sent on the wire.
LiveFrame.title: LiveFrame

MessagePosted.description: A message was posted in a thread. Its author is the envelope's actor.
MessagePosted.title: MessagePosted

PartStarted.description: The model started a response part: text, thinking, or a tool call.
PartStarted.title: PartStarted

PostMessage.description: Post a message in a thread, attributed to the actor who commits it.
PostMessage.title: PostMessage

ProposalResolved.description: A proposal was accepted or rejected.
ProposalResolved.title: ProposalResolved

ProposeChange.description: Propose a change for someone else to accept, whatever the write policy.
ProposeChange.title: ProposeChange

Proposed.description: The change was recorded as a proposal instead of being applied.
Proposed.title: Proposed

Recorded.description: The command was recorded; it changed no artifact.
Recorded.title: Recorded

ReplayComplete.description: Every event up to ``up_to_seq`` has been replayed; what follows is live.
ReplayComplete.title: ReplayComplete

Resolved.description: A proposal was accepted (the artifact is now at ``version``) or rejected.
Resolved.title: Resolved

RespondToProposal.description:
Accept or reject a pending proposal.

``changes`` is an optional patch applied on top of the proposed result when accepting, so a
person can accept a proposal with their own edits.
RespondToProposal.title: RespondToProposal

RunPaused.description: A run paused until the listed requests are answered.
RunPaused.title: RunPaused

RunStarted.description: An agent run started, or resumed after a pause.
RunStarted.title: RunStarted

RunUsage.description: Token and request counts for a run.
RunUsage.title: RunUsage

SetFocus.description: Set the artifacts a thread is focused on.
SetFocus.title: SetFocus

SetThreadMode.description: Switch a thread between ``edit`` and ``suggest`` mode.
SetThreadMode.title: SetThreadMode

StopRun.description: Cancel a run. Handled by the transport, not by core's rules.
StopRun.title: StopRun

SystemActor.description: The application itself, for automated changes.
SystemActor.title: SystemActor

TextDelta.description: More text for a text part.
TextDelta.title: TextDelta

TextEdit.description: Replace one exact occurrence of ``old`` with ``new``.
TextEdit.title: TextEdit

TextEdits.description:
A sequence of anchored replacements in one text field.

Each ``old`` must occur exactly once in the field at the moment it is applied. An empty
``old`` is allowed only when the field is empty, to write its first content.
TextEdits.title: TextEdits

ThinkingDelta.description: More text for a thinking part.
ThinkingDelta.title: ThinkingDelta

ThreadModeChanged.description: A thread switched between ``edit`` and ``suggest`` mode.
ThreadModeChanged.title: ThreadModeChanged

ToolArgsDelta.description: More of a tool call's JSON arguments.
ToolArgsDelta.title: ToolArgsDelta

UnknownEvent.description: An event type this version does not know, kept as-is so it round-trips.
UnknownEvent.title: UnknownEvent

UserActor.description: A person, identified by the host application's user id.
UserActor.title: UserActor

WatchRun.description: Receive a run's live frames on this connection. WebSocket only.
WatchRun.title: WatchRun

description: Frames of the artifactr.v1 thread protocol: `client` is any frame a client sends, `server` any frame a server sends.
title: artifactr.v1
